description: Register a cost for a model with no built-in pricing (required for self-hosted models: AgentGuard fails closed on unknown costs). Cents per 1,000 tokens. Optional agent_id, task_id and workflow_id accept identifiers only; spend_decide binds them into the signed actor. Read-only and cost-configuration tools accept these fields without recording a spend decision.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier; signed as actor.agentId on spend_decide

task_id.description: Optional task identifier; signed as actor.taskId on spend_decide

workflow_id.description: Optional workflow identifier; signed as actor.workflowId on spend_decide

name: set_model_cost
